title: The girl on the end stool
logline: Gully's daughter, thirteen, on the end stool with a coffee she's not supposed to have, from behind, the counter empty of anyone else, the corkboard above. The page lets her sit there.

panels.composition: A thirteen-year-old girl from behind on a shop's end stool with a coffee cup, the counter otherwise empty, the corkboard above, morning light.

characters.pose: thirteen, on the end stool, from behind

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a thirteen-year-old girl seen from behind sitting on a shop's end stool with a coffee cup at an otherwise empty counter beneath a crowded corkboard, morning light, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
